messages:
maya: Quick check — the SLO card summary in Console seems to hide contact routing when quiet windows are active. Oncall can't see fallback tier. Repro steps below.

jon: I saw that. Thought it was intentional to reduce clutter? @sara any concerns for oncall visibility?

sara: For incidents we need explicit fallback shown. Quiet windows shouldn't hide emergency routes. Can you paste repro?

maya: Steps: open SLO -> click alerting -> if Quiet Window enabled > alert surface shows 'muted' and no fallback info. Screenshot: https://redwood.internal/s/shot123. Minimal repro: 

```json
{
  "slo_id": "svc-123",
  "quiet_windows": [{"start": "22:00", "end": "06:00"}],
  "notify": {"primary": "#eng-oncall", "fallback": null}
}
```

jon: Ah fallback is null — UI treats null as 'no info' and then collapses the panel. We should show fallback even when muted, maybe greyed.

liam: If we show it, we need telemetry to capture whether oncall actually saw it. Currently no event for 'view-fallback'.

sara: @liam yes + we need a fencepost: don't expose e.g., PII fallback emails in compact view. But channel names ok.

maya: Proposal: change UI so when quiet window active, show 'Fallback: #eng-oncall (will be muted)' with a small 'Override' CTA for oncall to peek. Add telemetry event 'slo_fallback_shown' and 'slo_fallback_override_clicked'.

jon: Sounds good. API change? backend should always return fallback field even when muted. Right now it strips it.

liam: I'll add an API flag: `include_muted_metadata=true` default false. UI can set true for oncall routes. Should we gate behind a feature-flag 'slo-fallback-visibility'?

maya: Feature flag for the roll out yes. Start with beta for small tenants.

sara: Also add an alerting test endpoint so oncall can simulate 'muted' but receive a direct escalation. Might be separate.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout started for eng-platform/frontend commit sha=abc123 -> env=staging

jon: I'll open a tiny RFC in PR describing API contract and telemetry event names. Assigning @liam for API, @maya for UI copy, @sara for oncall playbook update.

maya: Thanks. Quick follow-up: P0 if oncall can't see fallback during paged incident. P2 otherwise.

liam: I'll push API branch by EOD.

sara: I'll update runbook after tests. :thumbsup:
